description: This file contains shell script code that sets up and tests the skip-worktree functionality in a git repository. It defines test cases to verify the behavior of git update-index commands related to the skip-worktree bit, including setting, unsetting, and verifying the index version after each operation.

methods.name: test_set_index_version
methods.description: Sets the GIT_INDEX_VERSION environment variable to a specified value.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description, executing the provided commands and checking for success.
